local_cli_status: Desktop bundled prerelease, not production pin; only version/help read, no live job run.

sources.verified_summary: Official TypeScript @openai/codex-sdk supports server-side startThread/run/resumeThread. SDK option mapping must be checked against pinned types.
codex exec supports noninteractive jobs, JSONL events and output-schema. Resume by exact session ID. Structured output is not content validation.
App Server and transport are experimental; SDK recommended for automated server jobs. App Server is not P0 default.
Native Windows restricted-identity/ACL modes exist. Working directory alone is not tenant read isolation. No local Docker/WSL/VM/MXC in this project.
Runtime file/network permissions must be pinned and tested separately from business authorization.
Repo-scoped .agents/skills provide instructions/resources; customer attachments must never become control skills.
